title: Test fixtures make unsigned commits, so parallel runs do not exhaust the signing service
why: Batch runner, batch 37 (#900), Oct 31 (via coordinator): parallel test fixtures exhausted the cloud commit-signing service ('too many open files'); the workaround was commit.gpgsign off for test runs. Cost real time today.
note: Fix: the shared test-repo helper sets commit.gpgsign false in each fixture repo it makes, so a fixture commit never calls the signing service. Real commits stay signed. Done check: the full suite in parallel in a cloud container passes with signing on globally, and a fixture repo's config reads gpgsign false. Needs no answer. Files: the fixture helpers in hooks/ and lint/ tests.
